title: GOV-0107: WP-UAT-A — freeze the badf-uat capability contract (G10 business-acceptance router; produces uat evidence only, technical E2E ≠ UAT; DESIGNED, no second gate)
problem:
🧠 **ARCHI (BARCHI-3)** — plan for WP-UAT-A: freeze the `badf-uat` capability contract (G10)

## Stage-Gate
- **Stage:** 3 self-exercise design → this WP freezes the contract only; no runtime, no Playwright adapter, no scenario-derivation engine.
- **Decision:** Continue — operator design directive received 2026-08-30 in the BARCHI-3 session: *"Proceed the badf-uat then move to badf-production-readiness"*, with the full business-acceptance-not-E2E design attached. Approval + A→E authorization recorded here.
- **Over-engineering risk:** registering `browser-uat`/`api-uat`/`mobile-uat` subskills up front, or a `scripts/badf_uat.py` that runs Playwright. Refused: freeze the semantic contract first — execution methods stay **adapters** described in one reference, not registered subskills (the directive's own §21 says this explicitly); deterministic G10 semantics stay in `badf_gate.py` at later rungs.
- **Glossary stage(s):** 10 UAT and release readiness (the `uat` slice only — see scope).

## Observed (measured on `main` `87dd192`, 2026-08-30)
- `webapp-uat` does not exist anywhere in this repository — it is an external reference only, exactly as the directive frames it (a browser-evidence producer to adapt, not a BADF definition).
- The provenance chain the directive wants (PRD → OBJ → AC → REQ → scenario) **already exists in schema form**: `schemas/acceptance-criteria.schema.json` binds to `prd_id`; `schemas/traceability.schema.json` already carries `requirement_to_objective` and `criterion_to_requirement` maps. A UAT scenario can bind to an existing RTM record rather than re-deriving traceability — reinforcing "resolve, don't reperform," the same discipline `badf-production-readiness` (filed #237) and `badf-release-validation` already hold.
- `badf/lifecycle.json` G10 requires `uat` among its four evidence types; nothing produces it today (the gap named separately as #238 / GOV-0106).
- **This WP claims `uat` only.** `release-packet` / `operational-readiness` are `badf-production-readiness`'s (#237); `go-no-go` is `release_authority`'s own act. No overlap between the two G10 programs.

## Acceptance criteria (WP-2026-0115 / BADF-DEM-0102 — measured across main + every remote head + all open PR file lists + issues; no collision)
- `skills/badf-uat/SKILL.md` — thin declarative router: purpose; the doctrine *"technical E2E verification does not establish user acceptance; BADF UAT begins from approved product intent, not from the application's screen inventory"*; the boundary (G09 validates the implementation independently; `badf-uat` records whether the exact candidate's business behavior satisfies what was approved; final acceptance is a separate human decision, mirroring `release-approval`'s and `security-approval`'s reservation to a human-authority role); the workflow `RESOLVE ACCEPTANCE BASIS → DERIVE SCENARIOS → SELECT ADAPTER → EXECUTE → CLASSIFY DEFECTS → COMPUTE COVERAGE → PACKAGE RECOMMENDATION → HANDOFF TO HUMAN ACCEPTANCE`; the twenty invariants **UAT-I01…I20 verbatim** as frozen by the operator's design; status points to the registry, never hardcoded.
- `skills/badf-uat/references/` — exactly fourteen: `g10-uat-contract` (the single evidence type this skill owns; boundary vs `badf-production-readiness`/`release_authority`), `acceptance-provenance` (the PRD→OBJ→AC→REQ→scenario chain, reusing the existing traceability schema's link maps — `UAT-I01/I05`), `scenario-contract` (the business-readable scenario object: source refs, actor/role, preconditions, expected business outcomes — `UAT-I02/I06/I07`), `scenario-derivation` (deterministic, criticality-aware derivation from AC/REQ; a scenario the RTM cannot anchor is not derived — `UAT-I01/I13`), `execution-adapters` (browser/API/manual/hybrid as adapters, never authorities; none registered as subskills at this rung — `UAT-I02/I09`), `environment-and-data-fidelity` (business-representative environment + declared test-data provenance/epoch — `UAT-I08`), `diagnostics-vs-oracle` (console/network/a11y/i18n are supplementary observation, never the business oracle — the `webapp-uat` adaptation boundary, `UAT-I10`), `defect-classification` (the ten-way failure taxonomy incl. `ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION_DEFECT` routing upstream — `UAT-I11`), `coverage-matrix` (AC/RTM/role/journey coverage, never screen coverage — `UAT-I12/I13`), `acceptance-disposition` (the two-layer artifact: automation's recommendation vs. the human's `ACCEPTED`/`ACCEPTED_WITH_CONDITIONS`/`REJECTED` — `UAT-I09/I14/I15/I16`), `reuat-and-staleness` (candidate/scenario/acceptance digest binding; a changed candidate stales the acceptance — `UAT-I04/I17`), `g09-g10-g11-boundary` (`UAT ≠ go-no-go`, `G10 ≠ deployment` — `UAT-I18/I19`), `acceptance` (ladder A→E), `external-methodology` (`webapp-uat`: ADAPT the Playwright/diagnostic mechanics, REJECT screen-inventory-as-scope and zero-console-errors-as-acceptance; sources characterized by the directive, not independently fetched — declared).
- `badf/skill-registry.json`: `badf-uat` registered `DESIGNED`, `risk_class` C1, `allowed_tools: []`, real digest; lockfile re-signed.
- **No** `scripts/badf_uat.py`, **no** new schema, **no** lifecycle change, **no** `badf_gate.py` change, **no** edit to any other skill's files.
- `docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md` doctrine section; DEM export; own composition record + typed G07 self-dossier; reconciles the land-time-current WP.

## Tests (`tests/test_badf_uat_contract.py`, failing-first)
- `test_contract_surface_is_declarative_only` — exactly the 14 references; no `scripts/badf_uat.py`; no typed schema yet.
- `test_root_states_all_invariants_and_the_workflow` — `UAT-I01…I20`; the eight-stage workflow; `TECHNICAL E2E ≠ UAT`, `SCENARIO ≠ PROCEDURE`, `AUTOMATION ESTABLISHES OBSERVATION, NOT ACCEPTANCE` present.
- `test_ownership_is_uat_only` — `g10-uat-contract.md` names `uat` as the sole owned type; `release-packet`/`operational-readiness`/`go-no-go` named as out of scope.
- `test_provenance_chain_reuses_existing_traceability` — `acceptance-provenance.md` names `requirement_to_objective` and `criterion_to_requirement` from `schemas/traceability.schema.json`, not a re-derived chain.
- `test_no_subskills_registered_yet` — `execution-adapters.md` states browser/API/manual/hybrid as adapters; no `browser-uat`/`api-uat` entries in the registry.
- `test_final_acceptance_stays_human` — `acceptance-disposition.md` states the disposition vocabulary and that the skill issues a recommendation, never the acceptance itself.
- `test_no_lifecycle_change`; `test_registry_pin_is_designed_and_tool_empty`; `test_skill_points_to_registry_not_a_hardcoded_status`; `test_external_methodology_is_reference_adapt_only` (REJECT list present, no vendored executable).

## Out of scope (later rungs)
- WP-UAT-B: typed `uat` scenario/execution/coverage/disposition schemas. WP-UAT-C: deterministic controls in `badf_gate.py` — lean disabled. WP-UAT-D: representative shadow (no real BADF UAT corpus exists yet; honestly caveated, mirroring `badf-solution-design`/`badf-security-design`/`badf-implementation-plan`'s WP-D). WP-UAT-E: product-acceptance-authority admission.
- Any `badf-production-readiness`, `badf-release-validation`, or `badf-engineering-verification` file.

**Version tier:** minor (new family, backward-compatible). **Lean mode:** advisory for A; **disabled** at C (human-acceptance-reservation / fail-closed invariants).

**Program goal (BARCHI-3):** carry `badf-uat` A→E, then move directly to `badf-production-readiness` (already filed as WP-PRDY-A / #237), per the operator's stated sequence. Shared-surface rungs go to BADF-QA and BADF-REV.

🧠 **ARCHI (BARCHI-3)** — approval recorded. Operator directive quoted above ("Proceed the badf-uat then move to badf-production-readiness") is read as approval of this plan and A→E authorization, mirroring the #195/#188/#209-style directives every prior rung in this program cited.
